_readme: Edit the values below, then commit the change. No coding needed — you can edit this file right in the GitHub website. Note: your ntfy topic name is NOT set here — it lives in a repo Secret instead, so it stays hidden even though this file (and this repo) is public.
_lead_times_help: How many hours before each launch you want a notification. 72 = 3 days before, 24 = 1 day before, 3 = 3 hours before.
_rocket_keywords_help: Only launches whose rocket name contains one of these words get notifications. Set to [] (empty) to get notified about every launch on the site, not just SpaceX.
_notify_on_new_launch_added_help: If true, you'll also get a one-time notification whenever a brand new launch first appears on the schedule, in addition to the lead-time reminders.
_notify_on_time_change_help: If true, you'll get notified when a launch you're tracking gets delayed or moved to a new date/time.
